test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The task of preparing national income estimates has been assigned to the ________.

options.text: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research

solution:
The correct answer is **Central Statistical Organisation.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Central Statistical Organisation (CSO):**

 
 
• The CSO is responsible for the coordination of statistical activities in India and for evolving and maintaining statistical standards.
 
• One of its key functions is to prepare national income estimates, which involve calculating the country's GDP and other related economic indicators.
 
• The CSO uses a variety of data sources and statistical techniques to ensure the accuracy and reliability of these estimates.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR):**

 
 
• This organization focuses on scientific and industrial research in various fields such as aerospace, biotechnology, and environmental science.
 
• It does not deal with economic statistics or national income estimates.
 
 
 
• **Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR):**
 
 
• TIFR is a premier research institution for advanced studies in fundamental sciences, including physics, chemistry, biology, and mathematics.
 
• It does not engage in the preparation of national income estimates.
 
 
 
• **International Indian Statistical Association (IISA):**
 
 
• IISA is a professional association that promotes education, research, and application of statistics in various sectors.
 
• While it supports the field of statistics, it does not have the mandate to prepare national income estimates.
